items.excerpt: MIRA, a Musical Intent Refinement Agent, aligns text-to-music generation with implicit user intent in underspecified prompts rather than a single global text-audio relevance score.
Smorph makes diffusion-based sound morphing playable for musical sound design by disentangling temporal structure from timbre transitions.
'Ghost in the Encoder' shows artist identity is decodable from internal representations of lyrics-to-song generation models, probing how they imitate artists or regurgitate songs.
